subject: RE: AtlasPay — request for IRP artifacts, telemetry, and post-incident timeline
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@atlas-payments.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: secops@atlas-payments.com
Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: AtlasPay — urgent: request for IRP artifacts and telemetry after suspected lateral auth attempts

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

We observed a series of suspicious authentication attempts across multiple AtlasPay service accounts on 2027-02-05 between 02:30-03:10 UTC. Our SOC flagged unusual token refresh patterns that appear to target Redwood-hosted connectors. We need to assemble evidence for our incident review and for our downstream auditor (Mandiant) — specifically: auth logs (token issues/refreshes), any gateway proxy logs showing source IPs, and a brief timeline of actions from Redwood’s side during that window.

Can you confirm you received this and share an initial packet (even redacted) and an estimated ETA for a fuller evidence bundle? We’d also like to understand if your IRP was engaged and any mitigation actions you took (key rotations, token invalidations, rule changes).

Thanks — Claire
Claire Dunn
Head of Security Operations, AtlasPay
claire.dunn@atlas-payments.com
+1 415-555-0183

Subject: RE: AtlasPay — urgent: request for IRP artifacts and telemetry after suspected lateral auth attempts

Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear you’re seeing those patterns. I’ve opened an internal IR ticket and looped in Marissa (Trust & Safety) and Soojin (Security Ops) to gather telemetry and coordinate retention of logs. Initial answers:

- We have live ingestion for auth events and a rolling 30-day store for full event dumps; we can produce a filtered package for the 02:00-04:00 UTC window.
- We will not rotate production customer keys without coordinating; if we recommend rotation we’ll call it out as an action item.
- Estimated ETA for an initial evidence bundle (redacted PII) is 48 hours; a fuller forensics package (with raw logs for Mandiant) in 72–96 hours depending on additional approvals.

Could you confirm the scope (all AtlasPay org IDs or specific client IDs) and whether you’ve already engaged Mandiant? That will help prioritize what we pull. I’ll start collection now and keep you posted.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Incident Response Lead — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
(415) 555-0210

Claire / team —

Quick update from the collection side: we pulled the 02:00–04:30 UTC window scoped to the AtlasPay tenant IDs you listed over Slack this morning (client IDs: atl-822, atl-824). The initial package includes:

- auth-event-sample-20270205.jsonl (samples with obfuscated tokens)
- atlaspay_syslogs_20270205.tar.gz (gateway + proxy summaries, first-pass redaction)
- redwood_irp_timeline_20270207.pdf (concise timeline and actions taken so far)

I uploaded everything to a shared Drive folder (link below) and added Mandiant’s intake address as requested. We kept full raw logs in a secure retention vault and will share on an approved SFTP if Mandiant needs them.

Immediate actions taken by Redwood during the event window:
- Short-lived token invalidation for suspect refresh events (temporary mitigation)
- Increased token validation logging and alerting rules for the tenant
- No customer keys were rotated during collection timeframe

Next steps we recommend:
1) If AtlasPay requests, we can create a scoped rotation plan for at-risk tokens (requires coordination).
2) We can provide a live call with our SRE and Soojin’s team for joint triage (propose Mon 2027-02-08 10:00 PT).

Link to artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/atlaspay-evidence-2027
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

Marissa Cole
Senior Trust & Safety Manager — Redwood Inference

Claire —

Thank you — confirmed reception of the artifacts and appreciate the quick coordination. Per Marissa’s note, we’ve scheduled the joint triage for Mon 2027-02-08 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Action summary and next steps:

- Redwood provided the initial evidence bundle to AtlasPay and Mandiant (links above). Attachment list is included below.
- Soojin’s team will remain on the call for any live pulls and to authorize transfer of the full raw logs to Mandiant via secure SFTP.
- If AtlasPay chooses token rotation, Redwood will provide a scoped mutual action plan and a pre-signed DocuSign for approval.

Post-incident/postmortem: We will produce a 1–2 page postmortem summary (timeline, root cause hypothesis, remediation actions, and next steps) and deliver to your security inbox no later than 2027-02-12 COB. If you’d like us to include a control gap crosswalk for SOC 2 auditors (SIG/CAIQ mapping), please confirm and we’ll add it to the PM.
